svg.title: What changes when retrieval gets bigger?
svg.desc: Seaborn stacked histograms of measured cue-request counts across eight synthetic requests at budgets 1, 2, 4, and 8. Lexical retrieval selects 8, 15, 24, and 36 pairs; 7, 8, 10, and 11 are eligible. The hand-annotated metadata control selects 7, 10, 13, and 13 pairs, all eligible. These are not LLM performance results.
